narration.text: A small carrier's driver qualification files kept current on four clocks: a full Clearinghouse query run before its twenty-four hours run out, an overdue annual query, two overdue driving records from the right states, one record ordered for a new medical status before the paper exemption ends, and an annual review signed, while a driver with no CDL is kept out of the Clearinghouse, a driver who left is left alone and nothing done this year is done twice. This is a chore for the safety and compliance manager of a small trucking company with eight drivers, who keeps the driver qualification files herself. On the bench, she found 6 of 6 eligible items, worth 540 dollars of the 540 dollars there was to find. She made no false claim. The world held 9 traps, and she walked past 9. She took 2 minutes. By hand, the same chore takes about 2 hours, so she was about 41 times faster. The verdict: exceeds. She beat the bar this playbook set itself. The bar was 75 percent of the money, no false claim and inside 60 minutes. Every card she filed waited for a person's signature, and nothing was sent.
